---
title: "Build"
description: "Define a reproducible PLLM system from configuration, models, components, and research methods."
---

- [SDK configuration](/sdk/configuration/) records what you intend to build.
- [Models](/sdk/models/families/) translate model-family settings into shared operations.
- [Model plans](/sdk/plans/) separate model structure from compiler and runtime support.
- [Components](/sdk/components/) select versioned capabilities.
- [Research methods](/research/recipes/build-method/) record provenance and plan changes.

## Python SDK example

```python
from pllm import Deployment, ExecutionBudget, Experiment, Model
from pllm.kernels import Cpu
from pllm.profiles import MaskedLinearCpu

experiment = Experiment(
    name="cpu-model",
    pipeline=MaskedLinearCpu(
        Model("Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct"),
        kernels=Cpu(threads=2),
    ),
    deployment=Deployment.local(root="local://cpu-model"),
    budget=ExecutionBudget(requests=1, max_input_tokens=64, max_new_tokens=8),
)
experiment.resolve()
assert experiment.pipeline.kernels.params["threads"] == 2
```

API: [Python SDK objects and signatures](/sdk/reference/python/pllm/#objects-and-signatures)
